No pricing option can be put forward yet, because the model could not test your **monthly churn <4%** limit.

- The comparison of £49, £55 and £59/month ran and held up under the changes tested, but that is only an MRR-oriented comparison; it is **not** evidence that any option meets the churn constraint.
- The result rests heavily on machine-authored estimates for active Pro subscribers, new subscribers, churn and feature-release value. The model marks feature-release value as a factor whose tested variation can change the ordering.
- Your £20k MRR threshold is recorded as **£20,000/month**, but the model lacks the baseline needed to assess that target in its calculation frame.
